notes: Starting cards as posted under '-Starting Stuff-': the Objective, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Prepared Defenses (posted 'Prepared Defense'), Power Of The Hutt, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement and No Bargain; several Effects start, so starting.effect is left empty.

The author's '-MISTAKE-' note says the starting sites should be the Audience Chamber, Great Pit Of Carkoon and Dungeon, dropping Tatooine: Jabba's Palace and Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm for Great Pit Of Carkoon and Jabba's Palace: Dungeon; not applied, dested as posted.
Posted 'What Are You Trying To Push On Us' is a Light card (What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?) in a Dark list, with no Dark counterpart; left UNKNOWN as posted.

Posted 'Jabbas Sail Barge Interior Site' dested Jabba's Sail Barge: Passenger Deck (the only Dark Sail Barge site); 'Boba Fett With Blaster' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Dr. E Blaster' Dr. Evazan's Sawed-off Blaster; 'Vibro Axe' Vibro-Ax (Dark); 'The Might Jabba' Mighty Jabba; 'Non Shall Pass' None Shall Pass; 'Tatooine Judland Wastes' Tatooine: Jundland Wastes.
Secret Plans is the pre-Reflections III Effect (not a Defensive Shield).
The strategy reports the deck went 2-0 against WYS at a local tournament (unnamed); filed as general.
